caption: The drawing depicts a single object, an ornate oil lamp or possibly a perfume bottle with a wick. The object is primarily colored in deep purple, with varying shades used to create the appearance of facets and ornamental carved details along its surface. The body of the object is elaborately shaped, with a square base supporting a tall, slender, and intricately contoured column that broadens out into a more bulbous, decorated form near the top. The top section is capped with a metallic-looking fitting, rendered in gray tones, through which a twisted white wick protrudes. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or decorations visible. The drawing is centrally composed on the page, and the colors are evenly applied, with clear highlights and shadows to indicate depth and texture.
title: Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
